notes: §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR12: 'Following the unsuccessful execution of a READ statement, the content of the associated record area is undefined and the file position indicator is set to indicate that no valid next record has been established', so the next sequential READ is 46 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4). Every failing arm of RelativeConnector.ReadSequential/ReadRandom returns through FileConnector.Unsuccessful, whose InvalidateFilePosition arms LastReadUnsuccessful, and SequentialReadGuard answers the next sequential READ with 46; a successful random READ or START (StartPositioned) re-establishes the indicator. The 2023 'unless otherwise specified' record-conflict case is unreachable at 85 (ImplementorDefaultSharing: ALL OTHER, no record locks). Witness: sequential at end then 46, dynamic invalid-key READ then READ NEXT 46, in a called and a calling program. Probes (dynamic, records 2/4/6): random READ 3 23 then READ NEXT 46 via USE (AT END skipped); random READ 4 then READ NEXT FFFF with KR=0006; random 23 then successful START NOT LESS 2 and READ NEXT BBBB; at end 10 then READ NEXT 46; CLOSE and OPEN INPUT then READ NEXT BBBB 00; after a 14 key overflow the next READ 46 (p3a).

next.reason: CHANGED under the round-1 ruling, difference 2: this rule is the 1985 statement of the indicator's value after an unsuccessful READ, which round 1 quoted as the 1985 side of that difference. 1985, with no exception: 'Following the unsuccessful execution of a READ statement, the content of the associated record area is undefined and the file position indicator is set to indicate that no valid next record has been established' (§1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR12). 2023: 'Unless otherwise specified, at the completion of any unsuccessful execution of a READ statement, the content of the associated record area is undefined, the key of reference is undefined for indexed files, and the file position indicator is set to indicate that no valid record position has been established' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR18), and it is otherwise specified for the record operation conflict, where 'The READ statement is unsuccessful' and 'The file position indicator is unchanged' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR10). The words that differ are 'Unless otherwise specified' and 'unchanged' against 'set to indicate that no valid next record has been established': a case removed from the 1985 result, and its result changed. A program with no post-1985 syntax reaches the condition: with no SHARING phrase or clause 'the implementor shall define the sharing mode that is established for each file connector' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23); with no LOCK MODE clause 'the type of record locking for that opening of a shared file associated with that file connector is defined by the implementor' (§2023:12.4.5.9.4 GR1); and when 'the record identified for access is locked by another file connector', 'the record operation conflict condition exists' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR9). The earlier KEPT rested on its 'Unless otherwise specified' covering 'lock conflicts (2023 only)', the premise round 1 refuted with those three rules. Carried, and no ground: the record area is undefined in both, in the conflict case too ('The content of the associated record area is undefined', §2023:14.9.30.4 GR10); 'no valid record position' for 'no valid next record' is a term for the same thing in a standard that also reads PREVIOUS. The at end case is the other thing 'otherwise specified' and is no ground: 2023 leaves 'The file position indicator is set to indicate that no next or previous logical record exists' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR24) where this rule leaves 'no valid next record', and both editions state the same result for the READ that follows, status 46: 1985 'The preceding READ statement caused an at end condition' (§1985:VIII.1.3.4), 2023 'if the previous READ or START statement for the file connector was unsuccessful, then the READ statement is unsuccessful and the I-O status is set to '46'' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR21; §2023:9.1.13.7 'The preceding READ statement referencing that file connector was unsuccessful'). GR24 is listed because it states the at end part of this rule's subject ('When the at end condition exists, execution of the READ statement is unsuccessful', with its NOTE 'The content of the associated record area is undefined as indicated in General rule 18'). Caveat, stated so that it is not mistaken for a missed observation: that same sentence of GR21 also gives 46 to the sequential READ that follows a conflict, so the ground is the indicator's stated result, exactly as in round 1's GR11 records, and not a different status on the next READ. This text is identical in VII.4.4.4 GR12 and VIII.4.5.4 GR12, so the two records take the same kind and the same 'to'; IX.4.5.4 GR12 takes them too and adds the key of reference.
